scope: Characterize fixed-injury fresh-read ability and the effect of one original rewrite, with a frozen diagnostic-choice prediction.
evidence_motivation: P02's signed-transfer increment was confined to 64 currently failing records; the current-pass increment was slightly negative.
enrollment: All 64 generation-14 body failures across eight exposed blocks and four histories; no terminal-outcome enrollment.
boundary: Fixed incoming or O-rewritten packet, original generation-14 injury, task rule, input/output geometry, reset/noise law, reader parameters, fixed settling phase and read-update budget.
causal_contrast: Outgoing versus incoming packet at the same fixed injury and shared fresh randomness; no rewriting during reads.
causal_direction: Unknown; the complete rewrite can improve, preserve or damage the packet.
directional_candidate: Choose the packet with larger 64-step task-aligned signed transfer after applying the fixed read injury.
endpoint: Strict native both-cue output margin >0.25 at 2048 updates, with fixed secondary budgets 1536 and 4096 and a 32-observation terminal window.
units: 64 related state records nested in eight blocks; 16 fresh streams per record, paired across options and time prefixes.
strong_rivals: four direct fresh-read probes per record option
evaluation_split: Replicates 0-3 choose the direct-read baseline; 4-15 evaluate every rule. All 16 estimate the declared complete rewrite contrast.
uncertainty: Per-state Monte Carlo Wilson intervals; equal-block means and all block effects; fixed 20000-resample descriptive block bootstrap. No significance gate.
resource_contract: Same native read budget for both record options. Signed diagnostics and direct probes have unequal observation cost, which is reported; no budget-matched repair claim.
failure_conditions: Signed choices failing to beat constant or unsigned choices narrow the predictive lead.
No incoming reread success under fixed injury would weaken usable-record recovery for this selected cohort and budget.
No outgoing advantage narrows any claim of useful rewriting of these failed bodies.
Apparent benefit only under altered injury would not answer this fixed-injury claim.
positive_interpretation: Development evidence of repeatable read ability, a complete writer effect, or a fixed diagnostic choice benefit within this apparatus. Interpret each separately.
negative_interpretation: Preserve the failure; do not change enrollment, budget, score direction or rival after outcomes.
mixed_interpretation: Report time, block and rival dependence and retain narrower scope.
holdout_status: New reset/noise draws under a frozen contract, but source states and preceding outcomes already exposed. No independent or unexposed-context confirmation.
long_run_policy: Detached, no automatic polling, automatic analysis and verification, no successor.
